Keep an open-palm karate-master fighting identity, not a wrestler or striker. The second image is choreography/layout reference only; copy its timing and body flow, not its identity. The third image is the approved Dojo Rookie for shared World Warrior material grammar only. The final three images are rendering-finish references only. Do not copy any reference character's face, hair, costume, or identity.

Every figure must be complete and separated on uniform pure chroma-green RGB 0,255,0. Bottom row: 5 backward fall fully visible; 6 one-knee recovery; 7 side-prone knockdown with face, circlet, and half-sash visible; 8 final defeated side-prone pose.
